1.name: OUT2B
1.hint: DMOS full-bridge output: off while ENABLE is high, in sleep and reset; shorted-load and short-to-ground protection (a short to ground latches until SLEEP goes high or VDD is removed) – a short to VBB is not named; motor output voltage -2.0 … 37 V

2.name: ENABLE#
2.hint: ENABLE (active low): high disables all FET outputs, low enables them; translator inputs stay active; no internal pull stated

3.name: GND
3.hint: pins 3 and 18 are internally fused; tie both to the PAD ground plane under the device

4.name: CP1

In addition, a 0.1 µF ceramic capacitor is required between VCP and VBB' – Class 2 dielectric ±15 %; no voltage rating given

5.name: CP2

6.name: VCP

8.name: VREG
8.hint: internal regulator for the sink-side FET gates, 7 V nominal

needs.source: Allegro A4988 datasheet Rev. 8, functional description VREG p. 10: 'the VREG pin must be decoupled with a 0.22 µF ceramic capacitor to ground' (class 2 dielectric, ±15 % max)

9.name: MS1
9.hint: microstep select MS1–MS3 (table 1); 100 kΩ pull-down; a change takes effect at the next STEP rising edge

12.name: RESET#
12.hint: RESET (active low): translator to Home, all FET outputs off, STEP ignored until high; no internal pull stated – a floating RESET is undefined

13.name: ROSC
13.hint: timing set: to VDD (30 µs off-time, auto mixed decay), to GND (30 µs, mixed decay always) or a resistor to GND (tOFF ≈ ROSC / 825 µs)

14.name: SLEEP#
14.hint: SLEEP (active low): low = sleep (outputs, regulator, charge pump off), high = run; 1 ms before the first STEP after wake-up; the typical application pulls it to VDD with 5 kΩ

LCSC product data C38437 (2026-10-31): ALLEGRO A4988SETTR-T, WQFN-28-EP(5x5), 46 245 pcs; JLCPCB catalogue 2026-10-31: Extended Part, 47 385 pcs
notes: Bipolar stepper driver with STEP/DIR translator up to 1/16 step, VBB 8–35 V, ±2 A, logic VDD 3–5.5 V with inputs at 0.7 × VDD (5 V logic needs 3.5 V high – a 3.3 V MCU does not reach it, maker-coverage MOT 13). RESET, SLEEP, ENABLE, STEP and DIR have no internal pull stated: a floating RESET is undefined (maker-coverage MOT 14). Outputs are DMOS bridges with body diodes (VF 1.2 V max) and synchronous rectification – no external clamp diodes in the typical application. Mostly bought as a carrier board (Pololu A4988 and StepStick-format clones; their sense resistors differ by board, maker-coverage MOT 10) – this entry is the IC. No behaviour model for a bridge driver: behavior none. Library draft.

2026-10-31: bridge outputs drive = bridge – the H-bridge outputs the datasheet of this draft describes (source above): driven high or low while enabled, off in sleep or coast; LEVELS counts them as defining their net (schema-gaps A2)
2026-10-31: CP1–CP2 0.1 µF and VCP–VBB 0.1 µF (A4988-DS Rev. 8, Charge Pump, read now)
open: CP1–CP2 and VCP–VBB capacitors are not to ground – pin hints only
the VDD 0.22 µF, VBB 100 µF and SLEEP 5 kΩ come from the typical application diagram, a reference circuit
the outputs' body diodes (VF 1.2 V max) have no field in the schema; REQ.missing (flyback) asks for a diode across a motor on an output pin – here a false finding
drive tristate makes a motor net driven only by these outputs an LVL.undefined/open_drain warning – no pin type fits a bridge output
short_proof: the datasheet names shorted-load and short-to-ground protection, not a short to VBB
r_out_ohm 0.43 Ω is the 25 °C maximum at 1.5 A; no value at temperature
RθJA 32 K/W holds on a four-layer JEDEC board – on two layers it is higher (not given)
